title: Stop D87 firing on merge 405s caused by pending checks
summary: D87's hard signal (watcher.rs) treats every landing merge 405/422 as "merge commits not allowed", but the November 405s (jobs 20261101-164247-5mrg, 20261031-031749-am9j) came from checks still pending. Make only refusals that are not explained by pending checks count toward D87, so the watcher stops opening false reviews. Goal: the maintainer's decision-state records reflect real falsification only.

defaults_applied.how: New watcher and landing tests; cargo test and clippy pass.
Fix the signal's input so pending-check 405s are not read as a disallowed merge method, not just suppress the one review.
Criteria run tests showing D87 does and does not fire.
Doc comments and CHANGELOG explain the exclusion.
No records or personal data committed.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/watcher.rs (load, evaluate, HostErrorSignal::matches, watch_landing) and grepped crates/athena-data/src/records.rs: MessageClass::MethodNotAllowed is derived from status 405 only (line ~1075), so the stored record cannot tell pending checks from a disallowed merge method. I assume the fix lives in the code that logs host errors during landing (crates/athena-core/src/gh/landing.rs, already knows check state after job 20261101-164247-5mrg) and/or watcher.rs, and needs no new record field. If a new MessageClass variant were needed, records.rs would be touched and must be accepted by `check_record_file` (records.rs:2932) and `AnyRecord`, with a round-trip test; I judge this unlikely, so it is not a firm deliverable.

Job 20261101-164247-5mrg (landed; findings: nit on landing_tests.rs comment naming candidate2.json, minor on hard-coded required check name): both are unrelated to this change and not re-fixed; its 11 changed files are kept as landed and not modified except gh/landing.rs.

Job 20261031-031749-am9j (landed; findings about later-stacked records-only commits, empty-replay reporting, and a linear-history check wording): unrelated to D87 and left as is; its files (gh/landing.rs, gh/mod.rs, async-drain.md, CHANGELOG.md) are kept, only landing.rs and CHANGELOG.md may be edited here.
Job 20261031-030119-tw3v failed in planning and changed no files; its drain.rs/tests/drain.rs wiring remains out of scope.
Existing records/ are never edited; the already-open D87 review is cleared only by the user.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-core watcher`: a new test shows a merge 405 recorded while required checks were pending does not make `evaluate` fire D87, and a 405/422 with checks complete still fires D87 on the first job.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core gh`: a landing test shows a merge refusal while checks are pending is not logged as a D87-matching host error (or is logged distinguishably), while a refusal with green checks is logged as before.

Grep of crates/athena-core/src/watcher.rs shows the D87_SIGNAL doc comment and name state that pending-check refusals are excluded; the signal name string stays unchanged so existing decision-state records (e.g. 20261031-085139-1y06) still match.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the pending-check 405 false positive and stating existing records/ are untouched.
Run `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`: both pass; `cargo test` passes including existing watcher tests (the 405 method-not-allowed derivation test).

out_of_scope: Editing any file under records/ or clearing the open D87 review
Reading branch protection to find the required check name
Adding new decisions' signals other than D87
hard_reason: Changes a rule that fires a decision review (the watcher's hard signal), so a mistake could hide real falsification.
